summary: Frontend verification for Live Partner Map toast-bug fix + Services premium UI redesign on preview URL. Primary bug CONFIRMED FIXED: watched Live Partner Map for 15s continuously — zero auto status-change toasts (no 'accepted a job', no 'Available → On Job'). Manual Refresh produced exactly one expected 'Live data refreshed' toast. All map elements, counters, partner list, city filter (Patna + all 15 cities present), status chips, drawer open, and partner-row click work. Services page renders premium header ('Services', '16 total · Search, filter & manage', Add New Service button). DataTable shows redesigned columns Service(image+slug) / Price / Rating / Featured(star) / Status(pill) / Actions(dup+edit+delete icons). Add New Service opens multi-step wizard (Basics/Category/Media/Variants & Plans/Highlights & FAQs/SEO/Publish). Search, 3 filter dropdowns, duplicate buttons (10), edit buttons (10) all present with correct data-testids. No uncaught console errors (only Google Maps advisory warnings).

ui_bugs.issue: Delete icon button has no data-testid (edit-svc-* and dup-svc-* exist; no del-svc-* / delete-svc-*). Functionality visually present but not testable via testid.

issues: Google Maps uses deprecated google.maps.Marker (console warning) and loaded without loading=async — non-blocking advisory

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='del-svc-{id}' to the delete icon in the Services actions column for parity with edit-svc / dup-svc.
(Optional) Address Google Maps advisories: use loading=async and migrate to AdvancedMarkerElement.
critical_code_review_comments: LivePartnerMap toast simulation loop correctly removed — verified by 15s observation window with zero toasts.
Real-data path + demo fallback working; counters (200 partners · 170 online) populated.
Services wizard list view: all core testids preserved after redesign (add-service-btn, dt-search, dt-filter-*, edit-svc-*, dup-svc-*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary bug (auto status-change toasts on Live Partner Map) is fixed and verified. Services premium redesign retains all functional testids. Minor missing data-testid on delete button in services actions — not a blocker. All 15 city options present in livemap-city-filter including Patna.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug fix verified; no new issue to RCA.
